master.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Grand Tourer, complete forest green highway tractor with its semi-trailer, carrying a flatbed with long steel I-beams, 22 tonnes, secured with straps or chains. chrome bull bar and air horns. polished paint with road dust. 1.17 m off-road mud-terrain tires wrapped in heavy steel V-bar cleated chains. Exactly THREE near-side road wheels TOTAL for entire vehicle with load (brief: three axles); make all three wheels identical, circular, centered rims. For semi trucks put one rear trailer wheel at left, tractor drive wheel and front steering wheel at right; for rigid work truck front steering and rear tandem.  strictly flat 2D side profile, camera perpendicular to the near side at hub height, no perspective, all tires the same size on one level line, no far-side tires. Right-facing, cab front face not visible. Horizontal chassis decks tanks and cargo. Every tire fully visible. Swamp Scout style: premium semi-realistic painted game illustration, dark contours, weathered materials, fine mechanical detail, natural texture, even soft daylight. Wide 2560x1024 PNG; entire vehicle occupies only middle 80% of canvas so TRANSPARENT 10% EMPTY MARGINS on all four edges. True transparent alpha background with empty pixels, no haze or vignette, no checkerboard, no ground shadow, no glow, no writing logos or watermark; banners if any blank fabric.

body.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target this assembled master vehicle-master-v1.png. Remove ONLY all THREE road tires and rims (truck and trailer); keep attached load, spare tire, equipment and every other pixel unmoved. Fill each wheel well with opaque painted dark inner liner/chassis/axle/suspension from fender lip down to original hub-center line, also gaps between tandem arches. No transparent holes above hub line. Below hub line and under chassis stays transparent except existing suspension. CRITICAL identical canvas width and height and pixel registration to input, no crop, no resizing, no movement, no redesign. True transparent PNG, no shadow halo or text. strictly flat 2D side profile, camera perpendicular to the near side at hub height, no perspective, all tires the same size on one level line, no far-side tires.

wheel.prompt: One wheel matching this Grand Tourer master; 1.17 m off-road mud-terrain tires wrapped in heavy steel V-bar cleated chains. Match reference rim color, hub design, bolt count and weathering. One perfect circle, centered hub, equal margins on SQUARE transparent 2048x2048 PNG, output at least 1500x1500. STRICTLY FACE-ON with no visible angled tread face or axle. Swamp Scout premium semi-realistic painted game art, readable dark contours, fine mechanical detail, natural wear and mud, even diffuse light suitable for rotation. No body, axle, ground, shadow, glow, text logos or watermark. True empty transparent alpha outside tire. strictly flat 2D side profile, camera perpendicular to the near side at hub height, no perspective, all tires the same size on one level line, no far-side tires.
